nodes.label: Chairside Voice Agent — Hands-Free Dental Assistant (#39)
nodes.rationale: Enables dentist/hygienist to interact with digital clinical record without touching keyboard/mouse, maintaining sterility. Audio never leaves the clinic (GDPR Art. 32). Estimated 43-69 agent-days across 3 parallel agents. MVP uses hotword 'Ehi Giulia' + push-to-talk fallback. Part of Fase 1 but activation gated behind separate compliance checks.
nodes.norm_label: chairside voice agent — hands-free dental assistant (#39)

nodes.label: Multi-tenancy — Schema-per-Tenant PostgreSQL Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each tenant gets dedicated PostgreSQL schema t_XXXXXXXX. Per-tenant-condiviso tables (no clinic_id) are shared across all clinics of a tenant; per-sede tables (with clinic_id) are isolated per clinic. TenantContext.validatedSchema() is the only safe way to reference tenant tables at runtime.

nodes.label: Copilot AI / SegretarIA — AI Assistant with Tool Calling
nodes.rationale: Text/voice AI assistant. Chat via POST /api/chat with Spring AI @Tool methods (getAppointments, searchPatients, getEstimates, etc.). No direct writes without server-side confirmation gate. Giulia is the voice persona; Copilot AI is the feature name. n8n handles telephony via Retell AI.
nodes.norm_label: copilot ai / segretaria — ai assistant with tool calling

nodes.label: Anamnesi Catalog per-Tenant — 15 Categories, 68 Items with Severity
nodes.rationale: Moved from global dentalcare schema to per-tenant schema (same pattern as service_catalog). Enables tenant customization. 15 clinical categories, 68 items with 3-level severity (normale/grave/severa). FK patient_anamnesis_item_selections.item_id repointd to tenant schema. Incident 24/07/2026: FK was still pointing to global catalog in prod, fixed in commit 3e4dbce.
nodes.norm_label: anamnesi catalog per-tenant — 15 categories, 68 items with severity

nodes.label: Anamnesi Severity — 3 Levels: normale / grave / severa
nodes.rationale: Replaces boolean is_alert. 'severa' triggers end-of-day scheduling constraint in AppointmentService.findAvailability(). No seed data ships with severity='severa' by design — value assigned at runtime only. IMM_HIV is 'grave' not 'severa' to avoid scheduling discrimination.
nodes.norm_label: anamnesi severity — 3 levels: normale / grave / severa

nodes.label: Anamnesi Selections — Append-Only with resolved_at Column
nodes.rationale: patient_anamnesis_item_selections gains resolved_at column. Never DELETE clinical rows — only soft-delete by setting resolved_at=now(). Re-selecting a resolved item creates a new row (audit trail), never reactivates old row. Unique index partial on (clinic_id, patient_id, item_id) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL enforces one active selection.
nodes.norm_label: anamnesi selections — append-only with resolved_at column

nodes.label: Fase 1 Roadmap — Vendible Gestionale Without Medical AI (Target: Jan 2027)
nodes.rationale: 4 sprints + parallel tracks. Sprint 0: DPO engagement + quick-win compliance. Sprint 1: clinical record probative value. Sprint 2: clinical model (encounter, consents). Sprint 3: identity/access. Sprint 4: hardening. Parallel: #39 Chairside Agent (43-69 agent-days). Critical path is DPO, not code. 'In questo progetto il codice non è più il collo di bottiglia. Lo sono le firme.'
nodes.norm_label: fase 1 roadmap — vendible gestionale without medical ai (target: jan 2027)

nodes.label: Fase 2 — MDR Certification for Radiological AI Module (Target: 2029)
nodes.rationale: Not started until Fase 1 sells. Trigger: N paying studios request AI radiology, or investor funds it. Realistica CE: 2029. Notified body queues: 6-12 months. Must predispose clinical dataset with legal basis NOW during Fase 1 while DPO is already engaged — cannot retroactively establish legal basis for training data.
nodes.norm_label: fase 2 — mdr certification for radiological ai module (target: 2029)

nodes.label: Go-Live Gate — All 16+ Criteria Must Be Green Before Real Patient Data
nodes.rationale: Binary gate: no real patients until all pass. Key items: radiology module OFF, append-only audit trail, finalizable notes, versioned consents, secretary cannot see clinical data (server-side), tech admin cannot see clinical data in plain text (break glass required), MFA, DPIA approved, DPA signed with all AI vendors, pen test done. Informal pilot with friend's patients = go-live without protection.
nodes.norm_label: go-live gate — all 16+ criteria must be green before real patient data

nodes.label: Voice State Machine — DISABLED / ARMED / LISTENING / REVIEW / SENDING / SPEAKING
nodes.rationale: REVIEW state is mandatory for clinical dictation — never skippable. Casual conversation with patient cannot trigger clinical write. Two separate gates: transcription confirmation AND action confirmation from Copilot. AbortController and cleanup on logout/destroy.
nodes.norm_label: voice state machine — disabled / armed / listening / review / sending / speaking

nodes.label: Wake Word — Local Processing Only, No Audio Leaving Clinic
nodes.rationale: GDPR Art. 32 compliance: audio processed locally via WASM (Vosk/Whisper.cpp) or LAN gateway. PCM recordings destroyed in RAM immediately after transcription, never written to disk. Hotword 'Ehi Giulia' detected locally. No audio to backend or external services. EU AI Act: visual indicator (green mic icon) when recording active.
nodes.norm_label: wake word — local processing only, no audio leaving clinic

nodes.label: CopilotConversationService — Shared Conversation State (Planned Refactor)
nodes.rationale: Extract from SegretariaComponent.sendMessage(): single source of truth for messages, current session, streaming, cancellation. Voice panel and chat page share same state — no parallel sessions. Prevents two concurrent sends. Block A of #39 implementation plan.

nodes.label: clinic_voice_settings — Per-Clinic Voice Policy Table (Planned)
nodes.rationale: Server-side policy always overrides local preferences. Fields: enabled (default false), wake_word_allowed (default false), allowed_stt_locales, allowed_tts_locales, default_speech_mode (brief), allow_full_sensitive_speech (false), provider. PUT only for admin/tenant_admin. Local preferences stored in localStorage but intersected with policy at bootstrap.

nodes.label: GDPR Field Encryption — HKDF + AES-256-GCM per Tenant
nodes.rationale: birth_date and fiscal_code encrypted per-tenant using HKDF+AES-GCM. Blind index on fiscal_code for searchability. Master key fail-fast on startup. Slice 1+2a live in prod; Slice 2b pending. Ordering rule: apply schema columns before views in patchSchema.
nodes.norm_label: gdpr field encryption — hkdf + aes-256-gcm per tenant

nodes.label: Clinical Record Probative Value Gap (P0 #18) — Audit, Finalization, Consents, Encounter
nodes.rationale: The project is 'molto avanti sul prodotto e molto indietro sulla prova'. Missing: append-only audit trail, note finalization with hash/addendum, versioned consents linked to plans, encounter as FK anchor for clinical entities. Sprint 1 of Fase 1 addresses this. Without it, the system is a database of clinical data, not a clinical record with legal standing.
nodes.norm_label: clinical record probative value gap (p0 #18) — audit, finalization, consents, encounter

nodes.label: DPO Engagement — Only Non-Delegable Critical Path Item
nodes.rationale: DPO must be engaged before end of August 2026 or Jan 2027 target slips. DPIA takes 4-8 weeks, requires DPO signature. DPA+SCC with Retell/OpenAI depends on vendor response (4-8 weeks). Only AI cannot compress this: needs a third-party signature. Code takes weeks at 50-100x compression; compliance takes months regardless.
nodes.norm_label: dpo engagement — only non-delegable critical path item

nodes.label: Secretary Role — No Clinical Data Access (Server-Side Enforced)
nodes.rationale: Secretary sees only operational summary: appointment count, treatment plan count, anamnesis status (compiled/not), alert count (no content). Cannot see anamnesis details, diagnoses, odontogram, clinical notes. Enforcement must be server-side — frontend check alone is insufficient (go-live gate requirement).
nodes.norm_label: secretary role — no clinical data access (server-side enforced)

nodes.label: JWT Roles — TENANT_ADMIN / DOCTOR / HYGIENIST / SECRETARY
nodes.rationale: 4 operational roles. TENANT_ADMIN owns the account (created at self-service registration V24), manages all clinics, not a per-clinic admin. ADMIN is legacy (demo tenant + n8n service token via POST /api/public/service-token with X-N8N-Key header). JWT contains: sub, role, providerId, clinicId. Two-phase login: pre-auth token then OTP confirmation.
